title: Road to the platinum
intro: Seven stages, built from the official descriptions. The order protects everything with a story window first, then sweeps the map, and leaves the 100% audit for last.

pointOfNoReturn.title: Point of no return
pointOfNoReturn.body: Save in a new slot before you launch the final mission. Every stranger strand, partner run and choice beat in stages 2 and 3 has to be finished by then; after the credits those offers are gone.

stages.title: Story run — Chapters 1 to 4
stages.note: Play the campaign first: it unlocks the map, the partner, the businesses and most activities. Each chapter trophy and each named mission trophy is a completion flag, so nothing here can be lost once the mission is done. Tick them as they land.

stages.title: Stranger strands
stages.note: Six named strands and the silver for eight completed strands. Run each line as its markers appear and finish it before Chapter 4 closes. This is the stage players most often lose to the endgame.

stages.title: Partner, choices and one-off moments
stages.note: The partner wanted-level runs, the story-choice bronzes and the flavour beats. Do them while the story is live and keep a save before each one-time scene.

stages.title: Collectibles sweep
stages.note: 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK check-ins, 100 vehicles, 52 areas, 8 garages and 10 app registrations. Route by district and let one drive feed several counters.

stages.title: Activities
stages.note: One round of each of the nine activity types first, then the long ones: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, plus fishing, arcade and bowling.

stages.title: Crime and challenges
stages.note: Five bank vaults, an armored truck, a silent jewelry job, nine gang operations, 50 challenges, the two money counters and the VCIA escape. Heist income funds the shopping trophies.

stages.title: 100% and the platinum
stages.note: The pause-menu completion audit is the final word. Clear whatever it still lists, then the platinum arrives on its own.
stages.why: 2 trophies: the 100% gold and the platinum.
